reuse.why: Introduces one shared selection used by all five month-wide actions, but ignores the tree's existing notion of a UI-saved template (template_settings source = 'ui', used in statements.ts and cleanup-template-notes.ts) and makes copyPreviousMonth run a second query and intersect ids instead of extending getBudgetData.

duplication.why: Removes three copies of the hidden-filter SQL into getMonthWideTargetCategories, though the income/tracking guard is still repeated in each of the five actions.

placement.why: The selection lives in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use it; encoding the rule purely in SQL is consistent with the tree, though it splits the rule between the query (hidden/template) and per-action code (income).

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, focused tests and a release note are touched; single-category actions are unaffected.

maintainability.why: One function now owns which categories month-wide actions write, which is easy to own, but the two-step filter in copyPreviousMonth and the separate income check are small rough edges.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing helper for month-wide category selection existed; the template check uses goal_def IS NULL rather than the template_settings source convention, which is a missed convention rather than a bypassed helper.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the repeated income guard is pre-existing and left verbatim.

one_place.where: getMonthWideTargetCategories in budget/actions.ts is used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg for the hidden/group-hidden/template rule.
